standard.summary: 给上下文前置一段可学习 token 的储备能力。当前只做到 seam 接线，运行时开关注入仍被闸住。
standard.effect: bank 为空或关闭时是默认路径，与未接线逐位一致；打开时前置的可学习 token 会带梯度参与训练。归档的 AGSM 与 dispersive 模式仍被封锁。
standard.whenToUse: 研究性质地验证「额外前缀 token 能否承载概念」时，用本地短测观察。
standard.avoidWhen: 常规训练里不要期待它——请求/配置接线与运行时激活都还没放行，产品路径上它不会真的前置 token。

standard_en.summary: A reserve capability that prepends a run of learnable tokens to the context. Only the seam is wired today; the runtime switch is still gated.
standard_en.effect: With an empty bank or disabled it is the default path and bitwise identical to not having the seam; enabled, the prepended learnable tokens carry gradients. The archived AGSM and dispersive modes stay blocked.
standard_en.whenToUse: For research-grade checks of whether extra prefix tokens can carry a concept, observed through a local short test.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not expect it in ordinary training -- request/config wiring and runtime activation are both unreleased, so the product path never actually prepends tokens.

advanced.principle: adapter_research_reserve_seam.apply_soft_tokens_reserve 在 bank 为 None 或关闭时直接返回原上下文；开启才前置可学习 token。价值验证记录为 5/5 与 13 个单测，均为本地 seam 级证据。
advanced.intervention: 上下文拼接位置的一次可选前置，不改模型结构。
advanced.expectedImpact: 目前无可宣称的训练收益；开启后序列变长，注意力开销随之上升。
advanced.tradeoffs: 这是一条默认关闭且未激活的储备路径，不能作为已交付功能宣传；产品界面也不应暴露成可启动开关。

advanced_en.principle: adapter_research_reserve_seam.apply_soft_tokens_reserve returns the original context untouched when the bank is None or disabled, and prepends learnable tokens only when enabled. Evidence is 5/5 plus 13 unit tests, all at the local seam level.
advanced_en.intervention: An optional prefix at the context-assembly site; the model structure is unchanged.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No claimable training benefit today; enabling it lengthens the sequence and raises attention cost.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: This is a default-off, unactivated reserve path and must not be presented as a shipped feature; the product UI should not surface it as a launchable switch either.
